R135 - PS4 goalie mask (maskid, masktype) read / inspection contract inputs (research package 3, 28 Sep 2026). Read-only.
Per distinct PS4 database source (anchors 15-19 / 21, genuine NHL 20 CUSA15439, NHL 19 patch 56, NHL 15 patch 00; the NHL 20 anchor is the
NHL 19 base copy and is recorded only as an alias) and the title's vault (gccollections/gcschema: shipped only in boot.big; the Extracted
copies equal the boot.big members - R135a):
  * catalogue: ge_nhl_goaliehelmettexturepack records -> (GoalieMaskTexture, GoalieHelmetBrand) with their typed ge_texture refs (FileRef of
    the colour map and of the brand-shared maps); ge_nhl_goaliehelmet brand -> ge_gameobject name (geometry record); throat protector brands;
  * every FileRef checked against the title's archive members (`nhl/data/kettle/<FileRef>.gnf`, any .big of the install);
  * goalie rows (exhibitiongoalieequipment): pair class = unique | ambiguous (>1 record) | maskid under other brands only | maskid absent |
    masktype not a catalogue brand (e.g. 99);
  * team slots (exhibitionteams.goaliemask<k>_{starter,backup}): value -> brands that carry it (a slot has no brand of its own);
  * Creation Zone: goaliemaskinfo.csv (assetid vs style*1000 + pattern; pattern/style in the catalogue), goaliemaskdisplayinfo.csv, and the
    thumbnail members creationzone[_xl]/equipment/mask/mask<N>.gnf with N decomposed as brand*1000 + maskid (a NAME join, reported as such).
Typed-attribute joins are data joins; which record the game draws, and whether it rejects a pair, is not observed.
Usage: python r135_ps4_goalie_mask_pairs.py <out.json>
